name: ToolLifeTracker
tagline: Cutting-tool and mould life at a glance – counts, regrinds, warnings and the next tool changes.
description: An advanced PCF control for manufacturers that tracks the life of cutting tools, moulds, dies and fixtures: shot/cycle counts, effective life after regrinds, warning and critical bands, a run-rate forecast of tool changes with replacement cost, and a validated crib/regrind/quarantine/scrap workflow – in Canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: KPI strip with due-in-horizon replacement cost
Grid, sortable table and forecast views
Effective life after regrinds with per-tool warning thresholds
Mould shots × cavities and next PM
Validated count, reset, regrind, return, issue, quarantine, release and scrap actions
Search, type, machine and band filters
Phone sheet, tablet and desktop layouts
State JSON, outputs and DOM event for automation
